title: AIA2: Attribute-Agnostic Imbalance Augmentation for Subgroup Robustness

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group classification performance across different target community subgroups (e.g., African, Caucasian, Homosexual) using the HateXplain hate speech detection dataset.

Measuring worst-group performance metrics across various natural data subgroups defined by text sources, disaster events, or specialized domains using datasets like HumAID, WWW2015, RE3D, and CrossNER.
